|game_text=Deploy on table. Your gangsters are information brokers. Your bounty hunters (except Boba Fett) are power +1. While Xizor on table, Scum And Villainy ignores Emperor. |errata_history=Versions of [[Jabba's Influence (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 3, slip 40 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Deploy on table. Your gangsters are information brokers. Your aliens at Jabba's Palace sites are immune to creature attacks. Your bounty hunters (except Fett) are power +2. While Xizor on table, Scum And Villainy ignores Emperor Palpatine. If Jabba at Audience Chamber, once per turn may ▼ any non-bounty hunter alien. A” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•40” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-40-Jabbas_Influence-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 9 November 2005 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]): “Effective immediately, these five virtual cards are being errata'd as follows:” “Deploy on table. Your gangsters are information brokers. Your bounty hunters (except Boba Fett) are power +1. While Xizor on table, Scum And Villainy ignores Emperor. Once per game, if Jabba at Audience Chamber, may \/ a non-bounty hunter alien. (A)” The post gives the text only (no slip image); in it “\/” and “/\” are the arrow icons and “(A)” / “[Immune to Alter]” the immunity icon. Stats and lore on this page are those of the earlier slip. '''What changed:''' the errata rewrote the text (full text above).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 40), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Your gangsters are information brokers. Your bounty hunters (except Boba Fett) are power +1. While Xizor on table, Scum And Villainy ignores Emperor. Once per game, if Jabba at Audience Chamber, may deploy a non-bounty hunter alien from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
